messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: P1 alert fired for eval-gate output-drift (rule: safety-regression). Pager: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12987 - routing to oncall

pagerduty-bot: ALERT -> eval-gate.output_drift | severity: P1 | service: eval-gate | triggered_by: automated-eval | runbook: /runbooks/eval-gate.md

claudia (oncall): acked. I'm oncall. Seeing a spike in safety gate failures across hosted-prod. Initial summary: safety-fail rate ~6% in last 5m (baseline ~0.1%). Region affected: us-west-2. Anyone seeing customer tickets? :eyes:

alex (support): yep - 2 escalations from enterprise customers reporting unsafe / hallucinated outputs in the last hour. Not widespread but definitely customer-visible. IDs sent to claudia via DM.

devon (eng-runtime): I'm pulling serving metrics now. Latency/throughput look normal. Trend shows a rollout earlier today: redwood-7b-v2-quant -> canary -> 40% traffic. Suspecting quantization profile change. Fetching rollout history...

priya (ml-evals): our automated eval suite flagged a regression on safety tests at 03:02 UTC. Failures concentrate on "manipulative-instruction" set and a few content-safety classifiers. I can run a quick local eval vs previous model to confirm delta.

sam (sre): starting mitigation: will trigger traffic rollback to pinned stable model and increase logging for safety classifier. Running rollback command now.

sam (sre): ```bash
# immediate rollback to pinned model
redwood deploy set-traffic --route hosted-prod --model redwood-7b-v1 --percentage 100
# api response: accepted, rollout id: r-84c3
```

incident-bot: rollback initiated by sam at 5250001290. Monitoring rollout and 5xx/4xx rates.

claudia (oncall): alex - notify impacted accounts with templated message (use incident template: model-safety-rollback). priya/devon - capture failing prompt samples and safety classifier outputs. Devon - can you confirm whether tokenization/detokenization changed with quantization?

devon (eng-runtime): quantization change: int8 symmetric from optimize service. No detokenization logic changed in the tokenizer layer. Quick grep on safety scores: 
```text
grep "safety_score" /var/log/serving/hosted-prod/*.log | tail -n 50
# shows safety_score mean shifted: previous mean ~0.12 -> current ~0.04 on recent requests
```

priya (ml-evals): running local eval: safety recall dropped from 0.98 -> 0.84 on eval-suite-v3 when comparing v1 -> v2-quant. Confirmed regression. Uploading failing sample set to the incident folder and will open a PR with analysis.

alex (support): sent initial outbound to affected customers: "We've detected a model safety regression and have rolled back to a previous model version. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a timeline and remediation." One customer asked whether any PII was exposed; none reported so far.

claudia (oncall): good. sam - keep monitoring infra; devon - please pause any further rollout. priya - attach failing prompts here. Also enable extra safety logging for 30m: set REDWOOD_SAFETY_LOG=1 on hosted-prod.

devon (eng-runtime): env set command: 
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/hosted-prod REDWOOD_SAFETY_LOG=1 -n prod
# kubectl: updated deployment/hosted-prod
```

incident-bot: Environment change recorded; extra safety logs are being retained for 7 days per incident policy.

priya (ml-evals): uploaded failing_prompts.csv to /shared/incidents/5250001234 — contains 152 unique failing inputs. Clustering: majority are instruction-following prompts with adversarial phrasing. Will attach top 20 to PR.

sam (sre): infra status: stable. No surge in 5xx after rollback. Safety-fail rate dropped to ~0.3% from 6% and trending down to baseline. Current customer-visible error estimate ~0.05% of requests.

claudia (oncall): drafting status page: "Investigating model safety regression; rollback to previous model completed; mitigation in progress." Alex publish to affected customers. Creating PagerDuty follow-up for postmortem: assigning priya and devon as owners.

devon (eng-runtime): opening hotfix branch to pin quantization config and add unit tests to catch safety score shifts. Will include a small canary with auto-eval gate before any rollout. PR will link to this incident.

priya (ml-evals): action items for postmortem: add auto-eval suite to quantization pipeline, add threshold alerting on safety score drift, and create blocking gate for quantization profile changes. I'll start drafting.

alex (support): customers acknowledged rollback and appreciate prompt action. Collecting customer logs for forensics; will attach to incident ticket.

claudia (oncall): ok team — if no further regressions in 45m we can close. Action list recap: priya write postmortem + add eval gate, devon PR pin quant config + add canary eval, sam confirm logs and retention, alex customer comms, claudia run RCA and close. Tagging :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident note added: "rollback -> stable model; failing prompts collected; follow-up assigned". Closing alert on PagerDuty after monitoring window.
